content.text: Empty last page case already red — matches the last incident.

Bulk import worker pagination has had three production incidents around empty final pages, page sizes larger than remaining rows, and source cursors that rewind after a 503. Coverage today is mostly unit tests on pure helpers.

Done when an integration suite spins a fake source API and asserts: empty last page completes the job; mid-stream 503 retries without duplicating imported issue keys; page_size=1 and page_size=500 both reach terminal success; metrics counters for pages_fetched match expectations.
